sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select ticket,customer,store,reason,days from v_attention order by days desc,ticket

sections.title: Production
sections.sql: select tag,ticket,description,stage,rack,due_on from v_production order by due_on,tag

sections.title: Ready for collection
sections.sql: select ticket,customer,store,pieces,days_on_rack,balance_cents,currency from v_order_board where status='ready' order by days_on_rack desc,ticket

sections.title: Run manifest
sections.sql: select run,run_on,driver,sequence,kind,ticket,customer,address,pieces,warning from v_run_manifest order by run_on,run,sequence

name: compliance
title: Record checks
subtitle: Checks of recorded evidence, not legal certification

sections.title: Follow-up required
sections.sql: select rule,country,store,record,finding,basis from v_compliance order by store,rule,record
